name: Birthday
title: A custom birthday song, written about them
heading: A birthday song about them, not just for them
desc: A custom birthday song written from your own stories about them and recorded in minutes. Hear it before you pay.
intro: Anyone can sing Happy Birthday. This is a song about the person: the thing they always say, the trip that went wrong, the way they laugh. You tell us, and Songpost writes the lyrics and records the song while you wait.
tell: A moment with them you'll never forget.
Something they always say or do.
What you want them to know this year.
together: A birthday song is even better from the whole family or a group of friends.

name: Anniversary
title: A custom anniversary song from your own story
heading: An anniversary song that tells your story
desc: Turn how you met and the years since into an anniversary song, written and recorded in minutes. Hear it before you pay.
intro: Where you met. The first place you lived. What you still do every Sunday. Songpost turns the story of the two of you into a song, with their name sung in the chorus.
tell: How it began: where you were, and when.
A moment along the way that only the two of you know.
Where things are now, and how they make you feel.
together: Children can make one together for their parents' anniversary.

name: Wedding
title: A custom wedding song for the couple
heading: A wedding song written for the two of them
desc: A custom wedding song made from the couple's own story: a gift from a parent, a friend, or the whole wedding party. Recorded in minutes.
intro: A song for the couple that could only be about them: how they met, what everyone saw before they did, what you wish for them. A gift nobody else will bring.
tell: How the two of them met, as you remember it.
The moment you knew they were right for each other.
What you wish for them.
together: The wedding party, or both families, can each add a memory.

name: Retirement
title: A retirement song for a coworker or parent
heading: A retirement song for someone who earned it
desc: A custom retirement song for a coworker, boss or parent, written from your stories about them and recorded in minutes.
intro: Thirty years of early mornings deserve more than a card passed around the office. Tell us what they were like to work with, and Songpost writes and records a song about them.
tell: What they were known for at work.
A story the whole team still tells.
What they plan to do next.
together: The whole team can add a memory each, so the song comes from everyone who worked with them.

name: Work anniversary
title: A work anniversary song for a colleague
heading: A song for a work anniversary
desc: Mark a colleague's years of service with a custom song about them, written from the team's stories and recorded in minutes.
intro: Five years, ten, twenty-five. A song about what they bring to the place is a thank-you people remember and play again.
tell: What the team relies on them for.
Something they always say or do.
A moment that shows who they are.
together: Colleagues can each add a line of their own.

name: Boss's Day
title: A Boss's Day song from the team
heading: A Boss's Day song from the whole team
desc: A custom song for Boss's Day, written from the team's own stories and recorded in minutes. Hear it before you pay.
intro: A good boss is hard to thank well. A song made from the team's own stories does it with warmth and a little fun.
tell: What they do that makes the work better.
Something they always say.
A time they stood up for the team.
together: Everyone on the team can add a memory from their own phone.

name: Thank you
title: A thank-you song for someone who went out of their way
heading: A thank-you they can play again
desc: Say thank you with a custom song about what they did and why it mattered. Written and recorded in minutes.
intro: For the teacher, the nurse, the neighbor, the friend who showed up. Tell us what they did and what it meant, and Songpost turns it into a song.
tell: What they did.
What it changed for you.
What you want them to know.
together: If several of you have the same person to thank, each can add what they remember.

name: Mother's Day
title: A custom Mother's Day song about your mom
heading: A Mother's Day song about her
desc: A custom song for Mother's Day, written from your own memories of her and recorded in minutes. Hear it before you pay.
intro: How she raised you. What the kitchen sounded like. The thing she still says when you leave. Tell us, and Songpost writes and records a song about her.
tell: A memory of her from when you were small.
Something she always says or does.
What you understand now that you didn't then.
together: Sisters and brothers can make one song together: each adds their own memories of her.

name: Father's Day
title: A custom Father's Day song about your dad
heading: A Father's Day song about him
desc: A custom song for Father's Day, written from your own memories of him and recorded in minutes. Hear it before you pay.
intro: The truck, the workshop, the advice you didn't want and later used. Tell us about him, and Songpost writes and records a song he will play more than once.
tell: Something he taught you.
What he always says.
A time he showed up when it counted.
together: Brothers and sisters can make one song together: each adds their own memories of him.

name: Valentine's Day
title: A custom Valentine's Day song
heading: A Valentine's song with your story in it
desc: A custom love song for Valentine's Day, written from how the two of you met and what you love about them. Recorded in minutes.
intro: Flowers last a week. A song about how you met, with their name in the chorus, gets played for years.
tell: How you met.
The small thing they do that you love.
What you want them to know.
together: This one is usually from one person. For a parent or grandparent, the family can make it together.

name: Christmas
title: A custom Christmas song as a gift
heading: A Christmas gift nobody else will give them
desc: A custom song as a Christmas gift, written from your memories of them and ready in minutes, so it is never too late to send.
intro: For the person who has everything, or the one who is far away this year. A song about them arrives in minutes, by text or email, with nothing to wrap.
tell: A Christmas you spent together.
What you love most about them.
What you wish for them in the year ahead.
together: The whole family can add a memory each for a grandparent or a parent.

name: New baby
title: A lullaby for a new baby, with their name in it
heading: A lullaby with their name in it
desc: A custom lullaby or welcome song for a new baby, written from the family's own words and recorded in minutes.
intro: A song to welcome them, with their name in the chorus and their family's hopes in the verses. A keepsake they can hear when they are grown.
button: Start a song for a new baby
forWhat: a song for a new baby
tell: Their name, and how it was chosen.
What the day they arrived was like.
What you hope for them.
together: Grandparents, aunts and uncles can each add a wish.

name: Graduation
title: A graduation song about the graduate
heading: A graduation song about how far they came
desc: A custom graduation song written from your stories about the graduate and recorded in minutes. Hear it before you pay.
intro: The late nights, the doubts, the day it clicked. Tell us what it took, and Songpost writes a song that says how proud you are.
tell: What they were like when they started.
A moment that showed what they are made of.
What you see ahead for them.
together: Parents, grandparents and friends can each add a memory.

name: Get well
title: A get-well song to lift their spirits
heading: A song to lift their spirits
desc: Send a custom song to someone who is unwell or having a hard time. Written from your own words and recorded in minutes.
intro: When you can't be in the room, a song can be. Tell us what makes them laugh and what you want them to remember, and Songpost does the rest.
tell: What always makes them smile.
A good memory to take them back to.
What you want them to know while they rest.
together: Friends, family or a team of colleagues can each add a few words.

name: Just because
title: A custom song for someone, just because
heading: A song for no reason at all
desc: A custom song about someone you love, for no occasion at all. Written from your story and recorded in minutes.
intro: The best time to tell someone what they mean to you is before there is a reason to. A few sentences from you become a song about them.
tell: What you love most about them.
A moment with them you'll never forget.
What you want them to know.
together: A group of friends or a family can make one song together.

name: A theme or feeling
title: A custom song about a theme or a feeling
heading: A song about a theme or a feeling
desc: Send a custom song about a theme or a feeling, such as young love, growing old together or coming home. Written and recorded in minutes, and dedicated to the person you send it to.
intro: Not every song has to tell someone's life story. Pick a theme or a feeling, such as young love, growing old together or coming home, and Songpost writes and records a song about it. Their name is sung once at the end, as a dedication.
forWhat: a song about a theme or a feeling
tell: The theme, in a few words.
What it should make them feel.
Pictures or moments to put in it: a gravel road, a porch light, a first slow dance.
together: Friends or family can each add a picture or a moment of their own.
